title: Denver office floor: dry bulb + DCV
climate: Denver, CO: dry. Humidity rarely matters; dry bulb works fine here.
spec: Referential dry bulb economizer. Changeover (high limit) 70°F.
DCV with a C7232 CO2 sensor: DCV setpoint 1000 ppm.
Prove full actuator stroke at checkout.

consequences.strategy: 30 days later: wrong sensors on order and a change order you have to eat. The engineer specced simple dry bulb.
consequences.DRYBLB SET: 30 days later: wrong changeover. Too low wastes free cooling (compressors running at 65°F); too high brings in warm air.
consequences.DCV SET: 30 days later: DCV opens too early (energy) or too late (stuffy conference rooms).
consequences.VENTMIN: 30 days later: wrong base ventilation when the floor is empty.
consequences.VENTMAX: 30 days later: wrong ventilation at full occupancy. All-hands meeting gets stuffy.
consequences.MAT SET: 30 days later: discharge air too cold or too warm during free cooling. Comfort complaints.
consequences.checkout: Never proved stroke. Damper was bound from shipping. Found on the callback.

note: Job specs are training values written to exercise the controller, not code-required values.
